name: spaced-repetition-deck
title: Spaced Repetition Deck
description: Sequences a set of cards through a single review pass (RF-2): shows the current card as a Flashcard and, when the learner rates it, asks a SpacedRepetitionScheduler (SM-2 by default) for the next state and due date before advancing. Presentation-only, no persistence -- it computes the next review state but never stores it, handing each result to the consumer via onReview. Composed from @didact/ui's Card/Button and the flashcard item -- see packages/core/src/components/spaced-repetition-deck.tsx for the full rationale.
